title: Evaluate Slice 1 and decide the next milestone
description:
# Evaluate Slice 1 and decide the next milestone

## Purpose

Turn the real-story evidence into a bounded product decision rather than automatically expanding scope.

## Deliverables

- Report coaching, blocks, recoveries, bypass attempts, false positives, and human interventions.
- Explain where the workflow taught, enforced, obstructed, or remained untested.
- Score the internal discipline claim only; explicitly withhold funnel conclusions.
- Record a proceed, revise-and-repeat, or stop decision with reasons.
- Identify which hooks are publication-specific and which repeated non-newsroom use might justify Kanbus review.
- Update the later milestone entry criteria based on evidence without prematurely creating implementation tasks for them.
- If the signal was zero, choose a harder real story or control only if it can answer a specific unresolved question.

## Verification

The Slice 1 epic can be closed only when its Definition of Done is supported by the real run and the decision record is attached through Kanbus.
